Who We Are We’re here to prove that the next generation of world-changing companies doesn’t have to come from a coast. It begins right here in Cowtown. TechFW is a nonprofit startup incubator and accelerator based in Fort Worth, Texas, helping entrepreneurs turn innovation into reality since 1998. We support founders at every stage through expert-led programs, strategic mentorship, and access to a powerful community. We work with scalable startups in biotech, hardware, AI, clean energy, software, and emerging technologies without taking equity. TechFW Startup Programs We meet founders where they are and help them get where they’re going. Whether you’re validating a brand-new idea, building your first product, or gearing up to scale, our programs are designed to support the real work of entrepreneurship. No shortcuts. No ego. Just the structure, coaching, and community you need to move forward with confidence. ThinkLab Startup Accelerator ThinkLab is our idea-stage accelerator for founders who are ready to stop

Built in collaboration with TMAC and Workforce Solutions for Tarrant County , MADE is designed to close the gap between promising ideas and scalable production by connecting companies to the tools, expertise, workforce pathways, and operational support they need to grow here. This program is for builders: the companies developing physical products, production processes, and next-generation manufacturing solutions who need more than advice. They need pathways. They need partners. They need infrastructure that can move at the speed of manufacturing. Apply Now What to Expect 🛠 Workforce + Operations Readiness Manufacturing growth depends on having the right people, skills, and systems at the right time. MADE will

MADE will support workforce credentialing, training pipelines, supply chain integration, and advanced operations support so companies can build stronger teams and more resilient processes as they grow. ⚙️ Prototype-to-Production Support MADE is built to help companies bridge the gap between concept and scalable execution.

Founders and manufacturers will gain access to prototype-to-production pathways, shared manufacturing services, certification readiness support, and practical guidance for both product and process development.

Through TechFW’s startup development experience and TMAC’s technical and operational support, companies will gain structured access to capital pathways, corporate and industry partnerships, mentorship, and collaborative spaces built to move ideas forward.
The MADE Manufacturing Accelerator and Development Engine is designed to change that.

Fort Worth was recognized in 2025 as the “ aviation and defense capital of Texas ” and MADE builds on that momentum with a bigger regional goal: to help position Fort Worth as the applied manufacturing capital of North Texas by creating stronger local production pathways, more agile workforce pipelines, and a connected innovation corridor across Texas.
You're a strong fit if: You’re building in aerospace & defense, reshoring, infrastructure, agritech, or workforce-enabling industries.
You’re developing a physical product, hardware innovation, production process, or advanced manufacturing solution that needs support moving from prototype to scalable execution.
You need access to manufacturing capability, certification readiness, workforce pipelines, supply chain integration, or operational support to keep growing.

ThinkLab is the Dallas and Fort Worth practical startup accelerator.
This 8-week, non-seed accelerator is designed for early-stage founders with a tech-enabled idea.
Expect weekly workshops, targeted assignments, 1:1 coaching, and real-time feedback from a community of startup experts and mentors.
How is ThinkLab different from other startup accelerators in Dallas or Fort Worth?

We’re local, embedded in Fort Worth’s innovation scene, and focused on helping you move from idea to execution with practical, step-by-step support through a community of entrepreneurs, mentors, and coaches.
